title: KaTeX – WordPress plugin | WordPress.org
hits: The KaTeX WordPress plugin enables you to use the fastest TeX math typesetting engine on your WordPress website. You can include TeX inside a [katex]...[/katex] shortcode or in a Gutenberg block. Either way the math will render beautifully on your website. When using Gutenberg blocks, the equations will render immediately inside your editor!
Equations in blocks or using the [katex display=true]...[/katex] shortcode will render on page in display mode–with bigger symbols–centered on their own line.
For compatibility with other LaTeX plugins, this plugin optionally supports [latex]...[/latex] shortcodes.
This plugin includes minified assets provided by the KaTeX project.
The source code is available in the KaTeX git repository on GitHub .
Upload the katex folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory or automatically download and install the plugin through WordPress’s plugin manager;
Use the [latex] shortcode or KaTeX Gutenberg blocks in your posts and pages.

title: Publii: Free Open-Source Static CMS for Fast, Secure Websites
hits: Publii vs Others Compare Publii with dynamic CMSs like WordPress, Joomla, and Drupal.
Download Trusted by creators for over 10 years. Create fast, independent websites with a privacy-first static CMS.

Publii is a free, open-source CMS that runs on your computer, not on a server. You write locally, and Publii builds a static site, which you publish to GitHub Pages, Netlify, Amazon S3, or your own hosting via FTP. No database. No PHP. No admin panel to break into. No tracking scripts unless you add them yourself.
